It’s insane how these pressure networks actually work.
They share the same funders, run identical playbooks, target the same people, and suddenly innovators get debanked, voices get silenced, and entire conversations get shut down.
One of them just got hit with an 11-count federal indictment for wire fraud, bank fraud, and laundering millions in donor money paid to informants inside the very extremist groups they claim to monitor.
The coordination is blatant. The hypocrisy is off the charts.
As someone who supports building the future — Tesla, sustainable energy, multi-planetary life — this matters. We can’t solve humanity’s biggest challenges if a machine of coordinated censorship keeps punishing wrongthink and free inquiry.
Transparency on the funding and tactics isn’t optional. It’s essential. Sunlight is the best disinfectant.
Free speech isn’t a luxury. It’s the foundation of real progress.
